paite: Jehoshaphat api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, apute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui uhi. Asik in atapa Jehoram alalta hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoram / (2 Kum 8.17-24)

paite: Ama'n unau, Jehoshaphat tapate anei a, Azariah, Jehiel, Zekariah, Azariahu, Mikael leh Shephatiah ahi uh. Hiai tengteng Israel kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapate vek ahi uhi.
Apa un thil thupi taktak apia a, dangkasik, dangka-eng, thil mantam pipite, Judah gam a kulh nei khopite toh; himahleh gamte pen Jehoram apia a, ata upapen ahih ziak in.
Huchi in Jehoram in apa gam luah in ahong kihihhatta a, a-unaute tengteng namsau in Israelte lak a intek tampi toh athat vek hi.
Jehoram bel kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahih in vaihawm apan a: Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
Ahab inkote hih bang in Israel kumpipate lampi azui hi: Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih loutak ahih hi.
Himahleh, TOUPA'N David inkote ahihmang nuam kei; David kiang a thukhun ziak leh amah leh asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak thak ana chiam khit ziak in.
Amah dam lai in Judahte lak a kipan Edomte ahel ua, kumpipa akibawltawm uh.
Huchi in Jehoram asepaih heutute leh akangtalai tengteng toh akuankhia a, zan in akuan a, amau leh kangtalai tung a heutute amau umkual Edomte asual hi.
Huchi in Edomte tuni tan in Judahte lak ah ahel lailai uh, huai lai mah in Libnah khote leng ahel uh; TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian alehngatsan ziak in.
Huan Judah gam tangte ah mun sang abawl a, Jerusalem mite a-angkawmsak a, Judahte apimang hi.
Huchi in zawlnei Elijah a kipan akiang ah lai ahong tung a, "TOUPA, na pu David Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Na pa Jehoshaphat lampite na tawn kei a, Judahte kumpipa Asa lampite leng na zui kei hi.
Israel kumpipate lampi na zui zaw a, Judahte leh Jerusalem a omte Ahab inkuan bang in ang na kawmsak a, na unau, na pa inkuante nang sang a hoihzaw na that lai hi.
Ngai dih, TOUPA'N na mite, na tate, na zite, na gante hipi in agawt ding a;
gilpi natna thupi mahmah na nei ding a, niteng in natna ziak a na ngoi teng atolhkhiak vek tan in na chi ana ding, " chi in.
Huchi in Ethiopia mite kiang a mi Philistiate leh Arabiate lungsim Jehoram sual ding in TOUPA'N atokthou hi.
Huchi in Judate ava sual ua, agam uah alut ua, kumpipa' inn a thil tengteng ala vek ua, atapate, azite uh leng; atapa naupangpen Jehoahaz lousiah atapa dang anutsiat kei uhi.
Huai nung in TOUPA'N hihdam thei louh gilnatna in agawt hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum nihna abei in anatna ziak in angoi apilhkhia a, natna mulkimhuaitak in asita hi. Amite'n apa meipi asehsak bang un asehsak kei uhi.
Avaihawm tung in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm a, kuamah it louh in asi a, David khopi ah kumpipate han lou ah avui uhi.
